integrity: The homotopy claim is supported by exhaustive simplex enumeration, a globally checked acyclic face-poset matching, exact signed Morse-boundary reduction, and an independent mod-2 homology cross-check.
scientific_limitations: The result is for the ordinary matching complex of the single graph G(8,3); it is not a uniform generalized-Petersen theorem.
Originality is relative to the inspected indexed literature and exact searches; unindexed prior computation remains a residual risk.
title: The Möbius–Kantor matching complex is a mixed-dimensional sphere wedge
